decision_rule: Seed 909. Six serial runs maximum, randomized adjacent pairs and coding order, simple_prompt first. $3 between-run standard-equivalent cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 720 active worker seconds. Test positive/negative graders and live activation before scaling. Stop on any screen task or protocol failure; preserve all attempts and unknown usage. Advance to fresh validation only if all six pass, simple_prompt uses no tools, and neither coding pair exceeds 20% treatment latency or cost overhead. A failed control or missing pair is inconclusive. Passing is feasibility evidence only, not evidence of code savings or adoption. Audit commands rather than treating fewer calls as less work. No subagents, no production defaults changed. Filesystem snapshots are per completed tool boundary, not an OS audit of transient writes; background writers are excluded.
